questions.question: Which French verb means 'to have'?
questions.explanation: 'Avoir' means to have. Key conjugation: j'ai (I have), tu as (you have), il/elle a (he/she has).

questions.question: Which French verb means 'to be'?
questions.explanation: 'Être' means to be. Key conjugation: je suis (I am), tu es (you are), il/elle est (he/she is).

questions.question: 'Je suis' means?
questions.explanation: 'Je suis' = I am. 'Suis' is the first-person singular of 'être' (to be).

questions.question: 'Il a' means?
questions.explanation: 'Il a' = He has. 'A' is the third-person singular of 'avoir' (to have).

questions.question: What is the French word for 'hand'?
questions.explanation: 'La main' means hand. Other body parts: le bras (arm), le pied (foot), la tête (head).

questions.question: {{userName}} says 'J'ai faim.' What does this mean?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai faim' literally means 'I have hunger' but translates as 'I am hungry.' French uses 'avoir' for hunger.

questions.question: How do you say 'My name is...' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je m'appelle...' means My name is... It literally means 'I call myself...' (reflexive verb).

questions.question: 'Nous sommes' means?
questions.explanation: 'Nous sommes' = We are. 'Sommes' is the first-person plural of 'être'.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'le livre' (the book)?
questions.explanation: The plural of 'le livre' is 'les livres'. 'Les' is the plural definite article for all genders.

questions.question: {{userName}} says 'Tu es mon ami.' What does this mean?
questions.explanation: 'Tu es' = You are. 'Mon ami' = my friend. So the sentence means 'You are my friend.'

questions.question: What is the French word for 'eye'?
questions.explanation: 'L'œil' means eye. Plural: les yeux. Other body parts: la bouche (mouth), l'oreille (ear), le nez (nose).

questions.question: 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' What does 'cheveux' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Les cheveux' means hair. The sentence means 'She has black hair.' 'Cheveux' is always plural.
